Anyway, here is the file:

# Review PI Transcript (Clone 2)

You will be helping me review my long-horizon context management system that I'm currently building. We have just implemented epic 5 of it, and it's built as a PI extension. PI is an open source extensible coding agent in TypeScript.

I am currently testing out a PI agent session where I'm actually using it to inspect its own codebase and capabilities as an agent inside the project repo and as an agent inside the harness.

I want to use you to help introspect into more session details emerging and potentially help me resolve anything that we may break or could disable the agent.

So please review the transcript of our conversation here:

/Users/leemoore/code/pi-long-horizon/docs/.post5/pi-transcript.txt

Please read this 500 lines at a time, then think about what was written and your emerging understanding as well as any follow-ups in docs or the codebase you want to follow up on. Output your reflections and then move to the next 500-line reading.

Once done with the full transcript, think more deeply about what you have discovered and what you want to research more in the codebase and output those reflections.

Then go through the codebase and investigate. Feel free to read the PRD and the tech design referred to here.

Do not read beyond what's in the codebase or in the PRD or tech arch, as we need to keep your context manageable.

The reason it's important for you to output your reflections is that later I will likely pull all of your tool calls at various points, and anything you read in tools may be gone, and we want your reflections to persist in the conversational transcript of the context.
